summary: First Busey Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration on its 8.25% Fixed-Rate Series B Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The dividend is $0.515625 per depositary share, payable on June 1, 2026 to holders of record as of May 15, 2026. No other events, transactions, or structural changes are disclosed. This is an ordinary dividend announcement, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, advisor names, premium, or risk-arb considerations.
